label: Diagram 3.12
caption: Diagram 3.12 Example of wheelchair adaptable WC/cloakroom layout with potential to be wheelchair accessible
description: Two floor plans are shown side by side. The left, labelled Example 3.12A – Wheelchair adaptable WC cloakroom, is dimensioned 1650mm across the top (with a 450mm section at the upper right) and 2200mm down the left side. Inside it shows a small square drain symbol in the top‑left corner, a washbasin along the top wall to its right, a WC pan at the top right, a shaded rectangular bath along the left wall, a dashed circular turning space in the centre, and a door at the bottom with its leaf swinging outwards. The right plan, labelled Example 3.12B – Wheelchair accessible WC cloakroom, is dimensioned 1650mm across the top, split into 1000mm on the left and 450mm on the right, 2200mm down the left, with an additional 1000mm vertical dimension on the left measuring the upper portion. It shows a WC pan at the top right with a dashed cistern rectangle above it, a washbasin mounted on the right wall, a shaded rectangular bath along the left wall, a dashed turning circle, and a door at the bottom with its leaf swinging outwards. Three numbered notes appear beneath the plans, stating that the dimensions are for illustration only; that doors must be capable of opening outwards (in wheelchair adaptable bathrooms the door may open inwards provided it can be easily rehung to open outwards, e.g. door stops planted and easily moved); and that stack and drainage positions are to be shown clear of the access zones where located within the WC/cloakroom. A green footer band reads Diagram 3.12 Example of wheelchair adaptable WC/cloakroom layout with potential to be wheelchair accessible.
